About us
Sky è la tech media company che rende l’intrattenimento e la connettività un’esperienza personale, semplice e senza confini.
Il nostro motto è We Believe in Better : crediamo che le persone meritino il meglio e innoviamo ogni giorno per creare valore e semplificare la vita dei nostri clienti.
Siamo parte di Sky Group e del mondo Comcast , operiamo in una realtà internazionale orientata all’innovazione continua e sostenuta da una tecnologia di eccellenza che ci permette di raggiungere ogni giorno milioni di persone.
Con un approccio IP‑first progettiamo piattaforme tecnologiche all’avanguardia – Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass e NOW – che integrano contenuti premium, informazione autorevole e non-stop, grandi eventi sportivi in un ecosistema semplice e intuitivo.
Parliamo a tutto il Paese anche attraverso i canali Free to air – TV8, Cielo e Sky TG24 – e andiamo oltre l’intrattenimento con Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile , offrendo connettività ultraveloce dentro e fuori casa.
È così che portiamo la joy of a better experience , guidati dai nostri valori:
Creative. Siamo ambiziosi e innovativi, abbracciando le nuove tecnologie e utilizzando gli insight per rimanere un passo avanti, alzando l’asticella della qualità per i nostri clienti.
Welcoming. Siamo inclusivi, collaborativi e rispettosi, creando un senso di appartenenza.
Simplifying. Ci concentriamo su ciò che conta davvero, definiamo le priorità, portiamo chiarezza ed eliminiamo la complessità
Do the right thing . Costruiamo una cultura basata su chiarezza, equità e fiducia con processi trasparenti e decisioni in cui le persone possano avere fiducia
Ruolo: Consent Management
Lavorare all’interno del team di Data Platform & Analytics (DP&A), significa entrare in un ambiente dove l’innovazione prende forma ogni giorno. Qui hai l’opportunità di progettare e realizzare soluzioni data-driven, trasformando i dati in insight strategici che elevano l’esperienza dei nostri clienti.
Il/la collega avrà l’opportunità di lavorare in un contesto altamente trasversale, collaborando con team di Data, Digital, Product, Marketing, Legal, Privacy e Technology per costruire un approccio sempre più efficace, automatizzato e scalabile alla gestione dei consensi e degli identificativi digitali. Inoltre, sarà protagonista dell’evoluzione della Consent Management Platform (CMP), contribuendo non solo alla compliance normativa, ma anche alla valorizzazione dei dati e al miglioramento delle capacità di riconoscimento e conoscenza del cliente.
Cosa farai:
Definire ed evolvere la roadmap delle iniziative di Consent Management, monitorandone l’avanzamento e condividendo aggiornamenti con gli stakeholder chiave.
Guidare l’evoluzione e l’ottimizzazione della Consent Management Platform (CMP), identificando opportunità di automazione e miglioramento continuo dei processi.
Collaborare con Sky Group per definire standard, governance e best practice condivise in ambito consent e digital identity.
Sviluppare report e dashboard per monitorare la raccolta dei consensi e supportare decisioni data-driven.
Coordinare l’integrazione di nuovi vendor e mantenere aggiornata la documentazione e le cookie policy in collaborazione con Legal e Privacy.
Supportare iniziative strategiche finalizzate a migliorare il riconoscimento digitale dei clienti e la qualità dei dati raccolti.
Identificare, valutare e mitigare rischi legati all’utilizzo di cookie, identificativi digitali e tecnologie di tracciamento.
Gestire relazioni e allineamento tra stakeholder con esigenze e priorità differenti, favorendo la convergenza verso obiettivi comuni.
Il tuo profilo:
Solide capacità di problem solving e forte orientamento al miglioramento continuo
Gradita esperienza nella gestione di piattaforme di Consent Management e conoscenza dell’ecosistema cookie e digital identity
Capacità di tradurre requisiti normativi e di business in processi concreti ed efficaci
Ottime capacità organizzative e di gestione di iniziative trasversali
Efficacia nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione con interlocutori di diversa seniority e funzione
Esperienza nella gestione del rischio e nella definizione di controlli e processi di governance
Curiosità, proattività e voglia di mettersi in gioco.
Cosa offriamo:
Per il CCNL Radio e televisioni private la retribuzione è a partire da: 45.000 €
Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato
La retribuzione effettiva sarà commisurata alla esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche possedute.
La posizione è inoltre eligible al sistema incentivante annuale.
Sky considera prioritario fornire un ambiente di lavoro sano, stimolante e attento alle esigenze individuali, sia nella sfera quotidiana che professionale.
In quest’ottica nasce Sky4You, il programma di Wellbeing concepito per accompagnare ogni persona nelle diverse fasi della vita, alcuni esempi di ciò che avrai a disposizione:
Accesso gratuito all’offerta televisiva Sky tramite Sky Q o Sky Stream
Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile a condizioni riservate ed esclusive
Assicurazione sanitaria estendibile ai familiari e conviventi
Polizza vita e infortuni
Accesso gratuito alla palestra aziendale
Sostegno economico per neo genitori e caregiver
Assistenza gratuita per la dichiarazione dei redditi
Buoni pasto
A questi si aggiungono iniziative dedicate al benessere psico-fisico e finanziario, campus estivi e corsi di lingua per figli/e, oltre a convenzioni e sconti riservati.
Hybrid Working
Lavoro ibrido che funziona davvero. In base al tuo ruolo potrai usufruire fino a un massimo di 12 giorni al mese di smart working per concentrarti senza distrazioni, in ufficio potrai confrontarti, creare insieme e prendere decisioni in spazi unici pensati per collaborare e dare il meglio di te.
Il nostro hub di Milano si trova a Rogoredo , nel quartiere Santa Giulia , a pochi minuti a piedi dalla stazione Milano Rogoredo (M3 Rogoredo FS, treni regionali/AV, Passante), zona ben servita anche da un servizio di bus . Facile da raggiungere anche in auto e motocicli , grazie ai collegamenti con le principali arterie cittadine.
Nello Sky Campus troverai: due bar, ristorante aziendale, lo Sky Cinema e vari spazi collaborativi dedicati all’innovazione e alla condivisione di idee. Nei dintorni troverai altri bar, ristoranti, supermercati e servizi vari.
Formazione e crescita:
In Sky investiamo nella tua crescita. Crediamo nella mobilità interna come leva concreta di sviluppo e ti offriamo opportunità per esplorare nuovi ruoli e percorsi all’interno dell’azienda. Con Sky Learn , la nostra piattaforma di apprendimento, avrai accesso a formazione continua, contenuti digitali e percorsi di upskilling e reskilling per crescere, evolvere e costruire il tuo futuro professionale.
Social Impact & Inclusion
In Sky crediamo nelle persone. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo , in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi sé stessa ed esprimere il proprio potenziale. Sosteniamo attivamente il benessere e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutti , incluse le persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (Legge 68/99) .
In quest’ottica, l’azienda ospita i network Body&Mind , LGBTQ+ , Women@Sky e Parents&Carers : community volontarie che riuniscono colleghi interessati a confrontarsi e promuovere iniziative dedicate al benessere, all’inclusione e all’empowerment femminile.
Lavoriamo ogni giorno per generare un impatto positivo e duraturo sulle comunità, grazie alle iniziative di volontariato Sky Cares , ai programmi di educazione digitale di SkyUp e alle esperienze immersive delle company visit degli Academy Studios.
Perché aspettare?
Candidati ora per costruire una carriera straordinaria ed entrare a far parte di un team brillante. Non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti! In Sky le idee diventano esperienze per milioni di persone.
Sky favorisce l’inserimento di ogni forma di talento. Tutte le candidature, incluse quelle appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99, saranno considerate in ottica di pari opportunità e inclusione, senza discriminazioni di alcun tipo. Sky Italia garantisce un processo di selezione equo, inclusivo e non discriminatorio.
In coerenza con questo impegno e con il D. Lgs 96/2026, Sky Italia non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e, né durante i colloqui, né contatti individuali e/o attraverso altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo.

MSD::/job/ITA---Lazio---Roma/Demand---Su.text:
Job Description:
We are seeking an analytical, proactive, and commercially astute Demand & Supply Chain Planner to join our Company Italia. In this role, you will be responsible for end-to-end demand forecasting, inventory optimization, supply alignment, launches and IQV analysis. You will act as a pivotal bridge between Sales, Marketing, Finance and Logistics, leveraging modern ERP platforms (notably SAP) and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) / Machine Learning tools to drive forecast accuracy, service levels, and working capital efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain demand forecasts across product portfolios, ensuring alignment between commercial expectations and supply capabilities.
Lead and coordinate the monthly S&OP process, partnering with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Logistics teams.
Monitor market trends, sales performance, customer demand patterns and forecast accuracy KPIs.
Manage inventory levels, safety stock parameters and product availability while minimizing obsolescence and waste.
Collaborate with manufacturing sites, suppliers and logistics partners to mitigate supply risks and ensure continuity.
Support product launches, lifecycle management activities and business-critical supply chain projects.
Leverage SAP, AI-driven forecasting tools and business intelligence platforms to improve planning processes and decision-making.
Prepare analyses and dashboards, including IQV and performance reporting, to support operational and strategic decisions.
Requirements
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Supply Chain, Life Sciences or another scientific discipline, or at least 2 years of experience in a similar Demand & Supply Planning role.
Experience in Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Inventory Management or S&OP processes; pharmaceutical industry experience is considered a plus.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform complex data into actionable insights.
Experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP, and planning tools.
Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence (AI), predictive analytics tools and digital solutions supporting forecasting and supply chain processes.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, data analysis and reporting).
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Fluent Italian and English , both written and spoken.
The applicable NCBA is CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico, Classification ‘Impiegato’, Level B1
The Primary Location for this position is
ITA - Lazio - Roma
The salary range for this position is
€41,200.00 - €70,000.00
This is the lowest and highest salary we, in good faith, believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. It is based on the applicable NCBA, as well as an individual’s experience, skills, organizational needs, and compensation levels within their peer group. If applicable, employees may also be eligible for an annual bonus, long-term incentives, or other benefits. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide further information if needed.
Required Skills:
Adaptability, Adaptability, Business Alignment, Change Management, Clinical Supply Chain Management, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Demand Analysis, Demand Forecasting, Demand Management, Demand Planning Forecasting, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), ERP Financial Systems, Excel Reports, Financial Forecasting, Forecasting Models, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), Industry Trend Analysis, Inventory Control Management, Inventory Planning, KPI Reporting, Logistics, Microsoft Excel Functions, Negotiation, Planning, Process Alignment {+ 7 more} Preferred Skills:

Diageo::/job/London-England/National-Acc.text:
Job Description :
About us:
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more
About the Function:
Sales is where our brands meet the real world.
This team builds the relationships that bring our products to life, partnering closely with customers across markets, channels and occasions to make sure our brands are part of moments that matter.
It’s a dynamic, people-focused environment where curiosity, commercial thinking and strong relationships make the difference. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your network, develop your skills and see the direct impact of your work every day.
About the role
To lead the commercial performance of Premium Grocery customers by developing and executing customer growth plans that deliver sustainable revenue, profit and market share growth for both Diageo and its customers. The role is accountable for building strong customer relationships, leading commercial negotiations, delivering agreed business plans and ensuring excellent execution through effective cross-functional collaboration. The National Account Manager acts as the primary point of contact for customers, translating commercial and consumer insights into actionable plans that create long-term value while maintaining operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
Key Accountabilities
Customer & Commercial Performance – Deliver agreed sales, profit and market share targets through effective commercial management of customer accounts. Identify growth opportunities and implement plans that drive sustainable business performance.
Joint Business Planning & Execution – Develop and execute customer business plans aligned to commercial priorities and customer objectives. Ensure all agreed activity is delivered effectively and generates the expected return on investment.
Customer Relationship Management – Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels. Lead negotiations, manage issues effectively and position Diageo as a valued and collaborative business partner.
Commercial Insight & Opportunity Identification – Use customer, market and consumer insights to identify opportunities, recommend actions and support decision-making. Monitor performance and adapt plans to maximise commercial outcomes.
Cross-Functional Leadership – Work collaboratively across Sales, Customer Marketing, Supply, Finance and other business functions to ensure excellent execution of plans and delivery of customer commitments. Act as a role model within the wider sales organisation and support in coaching and management of National Account Executive priorities.
Key Competencies
Customer & Commercial Acumen
Influencing & Relationship Building
Execution & Results Focus
Experience/skills required:
Experience managing customer relationships within a sales, commercial or account management environment.
Proven track record of delivering sales, revenue and profit targets.
Strong negotiation, influencing and relationship management skills.
Experience developing and implementing business plans and commercial strategies.
Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and generate actionable insights.
Experience working cross-functionally to deliver business objectives.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including understanding of P&L drivers.
Working with Us
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.
Recruitment Scam Warning
Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

IQVIA::/job/London-United-Kingdom/Suppli.text:
Supplier Services Analyst role
Location: London, UK (Flexible) (Hybrid)
This role sits in our UK Supplier Services Team. The team is responsible for maintaining relationships with distributors and pharmacies within the pharmaceutical supply chain. This includes oversight of data supplied to IQVIA and the provision of market insight services back to those suppliers.
Job Overview
Under broad guidance, supports the account management and business development teams in executing the data acquisition strategy. Provides high quality and on-time delivery of information solutions to our data supplier partners.
Assignments range in complexity from basic analysis and problem solving to assisting in the development of complex solutions.
Essential Functions
Delivers information services for a set of data supplier customers.
Gathers requirements, develops custom reports, fulfills report requests and responds to customer questions under minimal supervision.
Performs routine mathematical data analysis to develop customer specific solutions to unique business challenges faced by our data supplier partners.
Validates data deliverables.
Ensures that deliverables meet customer specifications including timeliness and quality.
Identifies and delivers proactive marketplace insights to customers.
Supports with Supplier data queries
Maintains effective internal communications with teams to keep apprised of activities within the customer base.
Proactively develops knowledge of the pharmaceutical marketplace from both traditional (pharma) and non-traditional (supplier) applications of IQVIA data.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree
Four (4) years related experience (business analysis, customer service) desirable
Demonstrated problem solving, analytical and customer service skills.
Experience with MS Office products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) required.
Experience working within the healthcare industry is preferred.
Experience with business intelligence tools preferred.
Technical proficiency with relational databases as used by IQVIA or business intelligence tools preferred.
Knowledge of current events and developments within the pharmaceutical marketplace, emphasizing issues concerning Retailers and Wholesalers.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

A career in Maison Valentino is your chance to grow in a reality where business and creativity meet and thrive in an inclusive, and open-minded community.
Maison Valentino believes in a colleague-centric approach, where our contribution and behaviors as individuals are the secret of our success as a community. Each Valentino colleague is crucial to guarantee that every need in Valentino is met with mastery, creativity, uniqueness, and care.
Position: EUROPE EVENTS MANAGER
Reports to : Head of Marketing Europe
The Europe Events Manager is responsible for driving and executing the Events strategy across Europe, ensuring full alignment with Valentino’s Global Marketing vision and Brand DNA.
The role contributes to strengthening Valentino’s positioning as a leading luxury Maison by delivering elevated, consistent and client-centric event experiences, designed to enhance brand desirability, exclusivity and long-term client engagement.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
Events Strategy & Brand Alignment
Define and implement the European Events strategy in line with Global guidelines and Valentino brand positioning;
Ensure all activations fully reflect Valentino’s codes, aesthetics and storytelling;
Guarantee consistency and excellence across all European markets.
Prepare structured presentations for HQ summarizing activities for approval.
Event Execution & Excellence
Coordinate the execution of events, including VIC events, clienteling activations, product launches, in-store experiences, and partnership animations in close alignment with the Global Marketing team;
Ensure a best-in-class luxury execution, with strong attention to detail, personalization and exclusivity;
Oversee and coordinate the European events calendar, ensuring prioritization and coherence.
Coordinate and directly manage the full execution of events, including VIC events, clienteling activations, product launches, in-store experiences and partnership activations, ensuring seamless end-to-end delivery;
Lead the operational planning of events, including timelines, production plans and detailed run of show for each activation;
Identify, select and manage all external suppliers (catering, agencies, production suppliers, entertainment, logistics partners), ensuring alignment with Valentino standards and budget guidelines;
Source and continuously evaluate new suppliers to enhance quality, creativity and efficiency;
Coordinate closely with store teams, Visual Merchandising and Store Operations to ensure proper in-store execution, setup and compliance with brand guidelines;
Supervise on-site execution when required, ensuring flawless delivery, attention to detail and problem-solving in real time.
Client Engagement & CRM Integration
Partner closely with the Client Engagement (CRM) team to define targeted event strategies based on client segmentation and insights;
Design events to support client acquisition, retention and loyalty, with a specific focus on VIC clients;
Ensure full integration between events, clienteling activities and CRM journeys (invitation strategy, follow-up, performance tracking).
Cross-functional Collaboration
Act as a key point of coordination between Global Marketing and regional/local teams;
Collaborate with Retail/Wholesale, PR, Beauty, Client Engagement and local Marketing teams to ensure seamless execution;
Manage external agencies and suppliers, ensuring adherence to Valentino standards;
In collaboration with HQ event production team, drive efficiency by continually identifying and evaluating new vendors and suppliers to enhance event delivery.
Budget & Performance Monitoring
Plan, manage, and review event budget across stores, monitoring activities, timelines and execution costs;
Define and monitor KPIs (client engagement, traffic, conversion, ROI);
Produce comprehensive qualitative and quantitative reports on events executed within the relevant regions and monitor return on investment;
Provide structured reporting and actionable insights to optimize future activations.
Innovation & Client Experience
Drive continuous innovation in event formats, enhancing the Valentino client journey and emotional connection with the brand;
Identify opportunities to elevate experiential marketing in line with luxury industry evolution;
Ensure all activations reinforce Valentino’s values of creativity, craftsmanship and exclusivity.

Job Title: Media Lead - Global Travel
Role Type: Permanent, Full time

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

1.Strategy & Planning
Own the development and deployment of integrated media plans across Paid Media, Retail Media, Social and Creator channels, aligned to global category strategy and media blueprint and Global Travel growth ambitions.
Lead cross-market alignment on Connected, Scaled Reach execution, ensuring consistency in approach while enabling flexibility to reflect local market dynamics.
Translate global media frameworks and category priorities into actionable, data-driven plans that deliver measurable business outcomes.
2.Activation & Performance
Oversee execution of integrated full-funnel media plans, ensuring optimisation of investment to maximise reach, effectiveness and ROI.
Drive media efficiency and productivity through strategic investment allocation, optimisation frameworks, and adoption of DMAF global standards and tools.
Monitor and actively optimise regional media performance against defined KPIs, ensuring delivery of both short-term results and long-term brand growth.
3.Data, Audience & AI Enablement
Accelerate adoption of data-driven audience strategies to improve targeting precision and business impact.
Drive the implementation and scaling of AI-enabled planning, buying and optimisation solutions to unlock productivity gains and real-time performance improvements.
Lead a test-and-learn agenda for Global Travel, embedding structured experimentation to continuously improve media effectiveness and inform future investment decisions.
4.Retail Media Integration
Ensure retail media campaigns are driven in line with the Retail Media Activation Framework (RMAF) and fully integrated within broader media plans.
5.Governance & Compliance
Ensure full compliance with the Diageo Marketing Code (DMC), Trusted Marketplace (TMP), data privacy and brand safety standards through upholding Diageo’s Media standards.
Proactively identify and manage risks related to media investment, data usage and platform integrity.

Lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders, including in-market teams, global teams, and agency partners, to deliver high-performance media outcomes.
Ensure Connected Reach plans are fully integrated within broader go-to-market (GTM) strategies, balancing global consistency with local relevance.
Challenge and elevate agency and partner performance to deliver innovation, efficiency and effectiveness.
Collaborate with the Scaled Reach team and wider regional hub to deliver a competitive advantage for the category.
7.Commercial Accountability
Accountable for delivering media’s contribution to category growth, including revenue uplift, return on interest improvement, media efficiency and share of market gains.
SUCCESS MEASURES
Delivery of media efficiency and productivity targets
Measurable improvement in media driven revenue, ROI and effectiveness metrics
Scaled adoption of AI-enabled activation and automation capabilities across markets
Growth in Retail Media contribution to overall media performance
High-quality, consistent deployment of Connected Reach
Strong agency and partner performance against defined critical metrics
100% compliance with DMC, TMP, data privacy and brand safety standards
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Experience
8+ years’ experience in media planning, activation, digital marketing, or media agency leadership, with a proven track record across multiple markets; experience with Travel Retail is a plus.
Strong experience managing significant media investments and delivering measurable improvements in media effectiveness, return on interest and business performance.
Proven success driving media transformation through digital innovation, automation, AI-enabled solutions and cross-functional collaboration.
Experience operating within complex, matrixed, multi-market environments with varying levels of media maturity.
Demonstrated ability to lead and challenge agencies and partners to deliver high-performance outcomes.
Technical Skills & Knowledge
Deep expertise across Paid Media, Programmatic, Social, Search, Video, with a strong working knowledge of Retail Media ecosystems.
Strong understanding of media effectiveness, audience strategy, measurement frameworks, and data-driven decision making.
Knowledge of AI-enabled media capabilities, media technology platforms, and evolving digital ecosystems.
Strong grounding in brand safety, data privacy, and responsible marketing practices.
Leadership & Capability
Strategic problem solver with the ability to translate global and regional priorities into actionable, growth-driving plans.
Strong collaborator management and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior leaders around media investment and transformation agendas.
Ability to lead through complexity, balancing standardisation with flexibility across markets.
Collaborative, accountable and hard-working leader with a focus on delivering business impact.
Key Behaviours
Growth mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
Data-driven and commercially focused, using insight to optimise performance and drive business outcomes.
Proactive and forward-looking, staying ahead of emerging media and technology trends.
Committed to operational excellence and responsible marketing practices.
Working with Us
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to set a higher standard, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity!
If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Job Description
The Director, Structured Content Authoring is a transformational leadership role responsible for accelerating the organisation's evolution from document-centric regulatory operations to a modern, data-driven and component-based operating model. This leader will establish the vision, strategy and governance framework that connects structured regulatory content, medicinal product master data and enterprise data governance to create authoritative, reusable and traceable information assets that support global regulatory compliance, operational excellence and future digital health requirements.
The role will lead the development of an integrated enterprise capability spanning Structured Content Authoring, IDMP data governance, regulatory master data, controlled terminology, metadata management and information architecture.
Working across Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Data Management, Labelling, CMC, Clinical, Safety, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Technology and Data organisations, you will align senior stakeholders around a common strategy, operating model and investment roadmap that enables consistent, interoperable and high-quality regulatory content and data.

A key area of responsibility will be establishing governance structures, ownership models, decision rights, quality standards and stewardship practices across regulatory content and data domains.
Oversee reusable content components and data assets covering labelling, CMC, clinical and submission content, ensuring information can be efficiently created, approved, maintained, reused and traced throughout the product lifecycle.
Provide strategic leadership for IDMP governance, including product, substance, organisation, referential, registration, manufacturing and packaging data, ensuring alignment with global regulatory standards and evolving agency requirements.
In partnership with Regulatory Technology, enterprise architecture and data engineering teams, you will shape the future-state architecture connecting RIM platforms, structured content solutions, master data management, terminology services, publishing platforms, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities.
Ensure that automation, AI and advanced regulatory technologies are grounded in trusted, governed and traceable content and data.
What you will need:
The ideal candidate will bring substantial experience of relevant life sciences experience and a proven track record of regulatory data governance, IDMP, RIM platforms, master data management, information architecture and digital transformation.
A strong understanding of global regulatory standards, including ISO IDMP, XEVMPD/Article 57 and EMA SPOR, is highly desirable.
Experience with Veeva Vault RIM, Structured Content Authoring platforms, data catalogues, knowledge graphs, FHIR, automation technologies and participation in industry standards forums would be advantageous.
Experience in establishing governance frameworks, operating models, ownership structures and data standards that support regulatory compliance, data quality, content reuse and operational excellence.
Strong strategic leadership, executive communication and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across organisational boundaries and build alignment within complex, cross-functional environments.

The GTR FP&A Commercial Senior Specialist will support the Global Travel Retail business by strengthening financial governance, improving commercial decision-making, and ensuring consistency across regions, customers, channels, and key commercial finance processes.
The role will act as a central FP&A commercial finance point of contact for pricing, promotional investment, customer performance, margin analysis, strategic planning, and commercial analytics. It will provide robust financial insights to support profitable growth, stronger visibility of business drivers, and disciplined investment decisions across the GTR perimeter.
The position is designed to increase transparency, standardization, and control over key commercial finance activities, while progressively enabling automation and process simplification.
Key Responsibilities
Commercial Finance, Pricing and Investment Governance
Partner closely with regional commercial teams, marketing team, and finance stakeholders, including House of Brands.
Support the governance of price, promotion, discount, and DD investment management across Global Travel Retail regions, customers, and channels, to ensure alignment of assumptions, methodologies, accuracy and reporting standards.
Perform financial analysis on trade margin, value chain, customer profitability, pricing architecture, identifying risks and opportunities linked to customer terms, trade investments, discounts, and pricing actions.
Support financial assessments for innovation gates, new product launches, and commercial initiatives.
Support the preparation, validation, and tracking of price lists, price letters, SAP price loading, and related pricing processes.
Customer, Channel and Performance Analytics
Consolidate global customer performance across regions, customers, brands, and channels.
Enhance visibility of key commercial performance drivers, including Net Sales, Gross Profit, trade investments, promotional spending, and customer/channel profitability.
Support the development of P&L visibility by sub-channel, enabling better performance tracking and decision-making.
Assess the financial impact of alternative commercial scenarios, including price changes, discount structures, activation plans, and investment levels.
Strategic Planning and Forecasting
Support Strat Plan coordination for the GTR perimeter, ensuring alignment across regions, customers, and key commercial assumptions.
Contribute to budget, forecast planning processes with a strong focus on commercial drivers.
Prepare analysis and materials to support senior management discussions and business reviews.
Key Stakeholders
Finance Manager GTR
Global GTR Managing Director and leadership team
Regional GTR Sales teams
Customer, Channel & Marketing teams
BU FP&A team
Supply Chain Finance
Experience, education and skills
University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, or related field.
Solid experience in FP&A, commercial finance, business controlling, revenue growth management, or financial planning roles.
Experience in a multinational environment, ideally within FMCG, spirits, consumer goods, retail, travel retail, or commercial finance.
Strong understanding of P&L dynamics, Net Sales, Gross Profit, trade investments, discounts, promotion, pricing, customer profitability, and margin analysis.
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, strategic planning, and performance management processes.
Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SAP, planning tools, BI tools, or reporting platforms is a plus.
Fluent English; additional languages are a plus.
Soft Skills and Competencies
Strong business partnering attitude and ability to work cross-functionally.
High analytical rigor and attention to detail.
Ability to manage complexity across multiple regions, customers, and stakeholders.
Pragmatic problem-solving approach and continuous improvement mindset.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for non-finance stakeholders.
Proactive ownership and ability to work independently.
Resilience and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, international environment.

Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church’s, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities.
JOB PURPOSE
The analyst is part of the Global FP&A team. This position will have a strong focus on the Retail channel and will be responsible for the preparation of the reports in order to monitor the Brand performances, the financial forecast/budget for the company and the profitability analysis by Region and Channel. The controller will support senior management, providing both strategic insights and in-depth analysis by working cross functionally across divisions/regions.
RESPONSABILITIES
Preparing management reports and KPIs, providing analysis of the key areas
Retail daily/weekly reporting for the top management, coordinating all regional teams
Monitoring Retail profitability, focusing on channels and seasonality
Coordinate the WW retail global tracking of new openings and closures in conjunction with all the regional teams and the HQ Real Estate department
Support the top Management with presentation, dashboards and performance indicators on all relevant projects
Supporting the preparation of Earning release analysis requested by the Holding
Supporting the preparation of budgets, reforecasts and 3-year plans in conjunction with all the different teams involved in the process
Assisting in Monthly and Quarterly closings and provide comments and analysis vs budgets
Carry out regular business performance analysis, analysing variances from budget/forecast, with focus on subsidiaries in conjunction with the opex controlling and consolidation teams
Monitoring Retail Capex spending against investment budgets and highlighting areas of overspend
KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS
Bachelor's degree (Finance or Accounting preferred)
3-5 years’ experience as business controller, consulting or audit
Background of experience in a Fashion/Luxury company is a plus
Fluent in English
Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
Experience with Planning tool/software, Hyperion and Tagetik a plus
Experience with business intelligence tools such as OBIEE and PowerBI is a plus
Good relationships skills, social intelligence and teamwork
Strong analytical, problem solving, organizational and interpersonal skills
Able to work under pressure in a complex & fast-changing environment
